integrity: The proof uses translated-simplex volume, conditional Dirichlet moments, inclusion-exclusion, and exact beta integrals. The packaged checker re-expands the relevant polynomials and integrates them independently with rational arithmetic. The marginal spacing and Greenwood laws are treated as established background and are not claimed as new.
scientific_limitations: The exact formula is proved for Dirichlet(1,...,1) spacings and does not extend unchanged to general symmetric Dirichlet parameters.
Positive covariance does not establish positive association or a full joint stochastic ordering.
The classical joint spacing law is known; the claimed contribution is the explicit mixed harmonic moment and correlation, with older broad spacing literature retained as an originality risk.
title: Maximum spacing and Greenwood dispersion have an exact harmonic covariance
